problem: The one-time pull_request bootstrap workflow used to land the trusted-base migration must not remain alongside the permanent trusted pull_request_target workflow because duplicate required job names are ambiguous and the candidate-controlled bootstrap would weaken the trust boundary.

decision.rationale: Keep exactly one authoritative required evidence workflow: the base/default-branch trusted pull_request_target workflow.

official_docs.verified_constraint: GitHub recommends unique job names across workflows when those names are used as required status checks because duplicate names can create ambiguous results.

alternatives.reason: Leaves a candidate-controlled workflow with the same required job name as the trusted workflow.
Leaves only the trusted base-authoritative required workflow.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The temporary .github/workflows/pr-evidence.yml bootstrap workflow is deleted.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: PR diff deletes the bootstrap workflow.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The permanent .github/workflows/pr-evidence-trusted.yml remains unchanged and is the only workflow providing the required validation job.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: PR changes only the bootstrap workflow and this governance manifest.

automated: Permanent trusted workflow must evaluate this cleanup PR from main.
manual: Direct deletion from protected main was attempted and correctly rejected by the repository ruleset.

governance.trust_boundary_change: Removes the temporary candidate-controlled bootstrap workflow, leaving only the base-authoritative trusted workflow.
governance.bypass_analysis: Avoids duplicate required job names and removes the remaining candidate-controlled workflow path after bootstrap.
governance.rollback: Restore the deleted bootstrap workflow only if a documented migration emergency requires it; doing so is itself governance-critical.

known_limitations: Merge requires an APPROVED exact-head GitHub review from a non-author, non-bot human under R-016.
